passages.text: You shouldn’t harm living beings, so long as strength is found. Nor should you knowingly speak falsehood, or take what is not given. Content with your own partners, you should stay away from the partners of others. A personage shouldn’t drink wine or toddy, as they confuse the mind. You should recollect the Buddha, and reflect on the teaching. You should develop a harmless mind of welfare, which leads to the realms of gods.
